description: Capability -> backend routing. Backends are logical names; concrete provider/model bindings live in adapters/<backend-adapter>/models.json. Agents and workflows reference capabilities only.

local.description: Locally hosted model (llama.cpp / vLLM / any OpenAI-compatible local endpoint). Cheapest; no external data transfer.

cheap.description: Low-cost hosted model for routine code, search summaries and context reduction.

codex.description: Codex CLI / API backend. Treated as one backend among others, not a special case.

qoder.description: Qoder-hosted model slot (bound in the adapter to a concrete model, e.g. a Flash-class model on a free campaign). Cheap-first candidate for routine code work.

devin.description: Devin-hosted model slot (bound in the adapter to a concrete model, e.g. an SWE-class model). Strong-first candidate for nontrivial code and review.

cheap-code.description: Small edits, boilerplate, grep summaries, context reduction.

vision-reasoning.description: Screenshot / frame / image inspection and judgement.

browser.description: Local browser automation through the agent-browser CLI. The model decides snapshot/action steps; execution is a plain shell command, so a strong reasoning model is preferred over a vision one.

orchestration.description: Planning and decomposition for the optional model planner (the default rules planner needs no model). Try the free-campaign Qoder slot first; fall back to the strong Devin slot and then hosted models.

escalation.description: Ordered escalation ladder. A task that fails or is judged too hard on one capability may be retried on the next. Not implemented as a runtime yet.
